title: Triune Purple Figures
description: A surreal illustration features three overlapping purple female faces with bright green eyes and dotted skin. One figure rests her head on her hand while another looks upward. The composition includes a large orange planet with tiny silhouetted figures, a circular portal showing a lavender field path with a lone walker and a floating insect-like creature inside a swirling vortex, geometric mountains, crystals, and abstract dotted textures.
